method: Actual JavaScript in Node VM; student isolation, recovery, host events and scoped teacher actions

checks.name: Teacher login and teacher reload start at the assigned roster
A student name opens that student’s existing management pages
Student accounts select their own record and preserve the original test credentials
Legacy unlabelled single-student v2 records migrate only to Jiwoo
Separate objective, writing and diagnosis records roundtrip for two students
Confirmed teacher classification affects only the selected student
Roster progress and latest-version review queues come from each student
Parent messages and internal memos remain separate across student switches
JSON export and print identify only the selected student
Reset clears the selected student and leaves all other records untouched
Previously bound report fields and confirmation cannot write into another student
Student login and unknown roster IDs cannot change teacher selection
Back and explicit roster return keep pending teacher comments
Storage failure keeps an unsaved draft available after switching away and back
Corrupted student storage is quarantined independently from the original student
A mismatched stored student owner is rejected without overwriting that source
Student-account session restoration derives the correct student identity
Other-student host events and old unlabelled host snapshots never replace current data
Late host-save failure from a previous student does not warn or alter the next student
